symptom: `mxcli check pers.mdl` without `-p` warned `widget dgAttr (datagrid) property configurationAttribute is not recognized and will be silently dropped on write [MDL-WIDGET07]` (and the same for configurationStorageType, storeFiltersInPersonalization, refreshInterval, columnsHidable, showEmptyPlaceholder, a column's minWidth/minWidthLimit/allowEventPropagation/exportValue), although `exec -p` stores each of them and `check -p` accepts them (mendixlabs/mxcli#1573). An Expression-typed key (rowClass, a column's columnClass) was worse: MDL-WIDGET42 ERROR "a plain-value property cannot hold the expression", so a script `exec` takes failed `check` outright, and so did `describe` output carrying one.
cause: DATAGRID has no embedded definition (sdk/widgets/definitions holds combobox, gallery, the filters, image): its .def.json is generated from the project's own package, and an embedded one would take precedence over that package for every write because RefreshWidgetDefinitions skips an id the registry already holds. With no project the keyword therefore resolved to no definition, and validateWidgetTreeIn fell through to validateStaticWidgetUnknownProps, whose vocabulary is the union of what the built-in widgets' builders read and describe prints; validateWidgetExpressionValues, given no definition and no item mapping, called every key a plain-value property.
fix: validate_widget_embedded_schema.go: for a keyword widget the registry has no definition for (DATAGRID, and its `column`), read the property list of the template mxcli embeds for it (widgets.GetTemplate; the grid's own keys, the `columns` item type for a column). A key the template declares (or the `<key>Params` of a text template) is accepted by MDL-WIDGET07, and its declared type decides MDL-WIDGET42 (Expression takes an expression). A key it does not declare still draws MDL-WIDGET07 with a did-you-mean from the template's names, now worded as what is true: it cannot be verified without a project. Nothing changes with a project, or for a built-in widget.
test: mdl/executor/validate_widget_embedded_schema_test.go (every key the template declares, derived from it); mdl-examples/bug-tests/1573-datagrid-by-key-settings-check-no-project.mdl
insight: `make check-mdl` runs `check` with no project, so the symptom is invisible to the usual loop (`check -p`) and shows only when a script is checked in a repo or by a tool without a project; the reproduction needs the pair `check` vs `check -p` on one file. The embedded template is the 11.6 baseline, kept conservative on purpose (widget-engine.md), so it is evidence of what a key IS and never of what it is not: the Data grid 2 template carries the same 40 grid keys and 21 column keys as the 11.12.5 package (3.4.0), but a newer widget version can add more, which is why an undeclared key is reported as unverifiable rather than as dropped, and why the misspelled-key case keeps its warning. Adding an embedded datagrid.def.json looks like the obvious fix and is the wrong one: it would change every write, not just the check.
